heroHeadline: Venezuela Announces 300-Person Prisoner Release Batch; CNN Investigation Finds Authoritarianism Persists Under Transition
heroSubtitle: National Assembly President Jorge Rodríguez announced May 19 that Venezuela plans to release 300 people including political detainees — potentially the largest single batch since the February Amnesty Law — but Foro Penal verifies only 768 actual releases from a government-claimed 8,600+. A CNN investigation (May 16) found cosmetic change masking persistent authoritarian structures: González remains in exile, no election date set, and PSUV institutions unchanged seven months post-Maduro. BCV resumed publishing economic data showing ~612% annual inflation in April 2026, while the IMF projects +4.0% real GDP growth for the year. Chevron completed its Orinoco Belt asset swap consolidating a 49% stake in Petroindependencia.
footerNote: Data sourced from UN, OAS, IACHR, OFAC, Reuters, AP, BBC, Al Jazeera, CNN, NPR, Washington Post, Bloomberg, Americas Quarterly, Efecto Cocuyo, Foro Penal, HRW, Amnesty International, ENCOVI, IMF, World Bank, BCV, Trading Economics, EIA, Chevron, Holland & Knight, Kaieteur News, Demerara Waves, and PDVSA official records.
